scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check:core-boundary && npm run check:contracts
scripts.check:fast: cargo fmt --all --check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run lint:docs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:shell
scripts.precommit: git diff --cached --check && npm run check:fast && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:fast: cargo test --workspace --lib --all-features --locked --offline && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
